brief.question: Build a desktop microblogging app (Rust/egui) that writes Markdown articles with frontmatter (title, date, tags, abstract) into Content/YYYY/MM/DD/<id>/, shows a tag sidebar, tag search and a scrollable list (title + 3-line abstract), Markdown editing with preview, snippets, JSON transaction logs per day, and button-triggered GitHub sync (pull + push), Hugo-compatible as stage 2.
brief.purpose: Personal microblogging tool for a non-coder, later synced with a Hugo website.
constraints: Rust + eframe/egui, cargo project in app/
brief.done_when: cargo build succeeds, screenshot shows the main view with sidebar tags, search, list and editor/preview; sync and transaction files work.

plan.title: Plan the layout: top bar, tags on the left, list of entries, editor with preview
Save articles as Markdown with date, tags and abstract in the Content folder
Add tag search, the 10-entry list and the tag tree
Add snippets, the menu-bar icon and the right-click entry
Add daily change logs and GitHub syncing
Build, take a picture of the app and check it
